minProfiles.text: Profiles above which filters start to save real work

messages.businessImpact: Every variation in targeting needs its own group, so the group list grows faster than the policy list and nobody can say what a device will receive.
remediation: Create filters for the common distinctions, such as operating system version, ownership and device naming.
Apply them to existing assignments rather than creating more groups.
messages.cannotSee: Whether assignment filters would help depends on how the estate is targeted. A tenant whose groups already express what a filter would express has the same control by another route, and this cannot tell that apart from a tenant that has never considered filters.
